lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots organized in approximately four to five horizontal rows along the lateral flank. The spots increase in diameter and spacing as they progress posteriorly from the gill slits toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are discernible, creating a grid-like configuration where they intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, particularly evident in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible. The most dorsal ridge exhibits a high-contrast gradient with bright pixels on the upper edge and a dark shadow immediately below, maintaining a parallel trajectory relative to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of smaller, lower-intensity high-luminance blobs compared to the flank. These are concentrated primarily in the lower two-thirds of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Intense light scattering and bubble clusters in the upper-left quadrant of the frame partially occlude the cephalic region and anterior dorsal surface.
